name: UNSTIRRED WATER BATH
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Unstirred Water Bath is a fundamental general-purpose constant temperature instrument utilized in clinical, educational, and microbiological labs. It is perfect for safely warming reagents, melting agar, and incubating sample tubes. Designed with a robust double-walled structure, 5-sided glass wool insulation, and an advanced digital PID controller, it provides an incredibly stable, vibration-free heating environment with minimal maintenance.
features: Designed for highly stable constant temperature control
Rugged double wall construction with corrosion resistant exterior
5 sides glass wool insulation ensures minimum heat loss
Thick gauge 304 stainless steel tank for easy maintenance
Advanced Microprocessor PID temperature controller with auto-tuning
Supplied with a stainless steel perforated tray to place slides and flasks

specifications.Temperature Controller: PID controller with LED display of SV & PV
specifications.Heater: Immersion type stainless steel heating elements (ISI Marked)
